honest.app.configureHostResolver: the engine resolves hosts as the desktop's browser does
honest.app.disableDomainBlockingFor3DAPIs: the engine's policy, not the app's
honest.app.disableHardwareAcceleration: the engine decides for every page
honest.app.enableSandbox: pages are sandboxed unless they ask for Node
honest.app.isEmojiPanelSupported: false on Linux, as in Electron
honest.app.isHardwareAccelerationEnabled: the engine draws with the GPU
honest.autoUpdater.quitAndInstall: Electron has no autoUpdater on Linux
honest.BaseWindow.isResizable: the desktop can always size a window
honest.BaseWindow.setBounds: the desktop places and sizes windows
honest.BaseWindow.setContentBounds: the desktop places and sizes windows
honest.BaseWindow.setIcon: the desktop names windows by the app's icon
honest.BaseWindow.setProgressBar: the shell shows no progress yet
honest.BaseWindow.setTitleBarOverlay: the shell draws the title bar
honest.crashReporter.getLastCrashReport: the host sends no crash reports
honest.crashReporter.getUploadedReports: the host sends no crash reports
honest.globalShortcut.isRegistered: register refuses every shortcut, so none is
honest.WebContents.addWorkSpace: a workspace is DevTools', and the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContents.closeDevTools: the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContents.getBackgroundThrottling: the engine throttles hidden pages as the browser does
honest.WebContents.isDevToolsFocused: the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContents.isDevToolsOpened: the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContents.openDevTools: the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContents.removeWorkSpace: a workspace is DevTools', and the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContents.setBackgroundThrottling: the engine throttles hidden pages as the browser does
honest.WebContents.toggleDevTools: the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContentsView.removeChildView: a view never holds views here: addChildView refuses

lies.app.setClientCertRequestPasswordHandler: the handler is never called: the engine asks no one for a smart card's PIN
lies.BaseWindow.flashFrame: does nothing, where it should ask for the user's attention
lies.BaseWindow.getMediaSourceId: always empty, so the app can't name its own window to desktopCapturer
lies.BaseWindow.setIgnoreMouseEvents: does nothing, so a click-through overlay takes the clicks
lies.ServiceWorkers.getWorkerFromVersionID: always nothing: the engine gives the app no handle on a running worker
